zh: 图像是噪声较多的高反差裁切，中央有一片浅色密集区域。
中央密集区域被数处深色开口和不规则斑块打断。
右侧大部分区域由深色块面占据。
上、下边缘附近还可见较小的浅色和深色标记。
当前裁切没有保留清晰的痕迹外轮廓。
当前阈值化图像不足以可靠区分单独笔画。
en: The image is a noisy high-contrast crop with a pale central mass.
Several dark openings and irregular patches interrupt the central mass.
A large dark area occupies much of the right side.
Smaller pale and dark marks appear near the upper and lower edges.
The crop does not preserve a clean outer boundary for the marks.
The thresholded image does not support reliable stroke separation.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
